title: Lattice Configuration
description: lattice.json, the one config file of a Lattice repo. Everything in it is optional: workspaces, their dependencies and their tasks come from the repo's own manifests, and this file only says what those cannot.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON Schema (e.g. ".lattice/schema.json").

latticeVersion.description: The version of Lattice this repo runs. An installed binary that is not this version installs it and hands over, so everyone gets the same build.

workspaces.description: Directories, or globs of them, that are workspaces on top of the ones the repo's own workspace files (package.json workspaces, pnpm-workspace.yaml, Cargo [workspace], go.work, uv, deno) already name. Relative to the repo root. `"."` makes the root a workspace.

exclude.description: Globs of workspace paths to leave out, whoever named them.

engines.description: Tool versions every workspace runs with. An override can pin a different one for its workspaces.

globalDependencies.description: Repo-root-relative globs hashed into every task's cache key. Use for files shared across workspaces, such as a base tsconfig, a schema directory, or a root .env.

globalEnv.description: Environment variable names whose values are hashed into every task's cache key.

tasks.description: How tasks behave in every workspace that has them. A task does not have to be listed here to run: any task a workspace's own files define can be run by name.

overrides.description: Settings for particular workspaces. A key is a workspace name, or a glob over workspace paths when it contains a `/` or a glob character.

name.description: The name Lattice uses for the workspace, in place of the one its manifest gives it.

driver.description: The tool that runs this workspace's tasks, when Lattice cannot tell from its files. `"none"` for a workspace whose every task is written out under `tasks`.

engines.description: Tool versions for this workspace, over the root `engines`.

dependsOn.description: Workspaces this one depends on beyond what its manifest says, such as an edge between languages.

tasks.description: This workspace's tasks: a command string, or a task object whose `run` is the command and whose other fields override the root `tasks` map.

engines.description: Name-keyed map of engine constraints. Each value is either a version constraint string or a detailed engine spec object.

versionCmd.description: Command that prints the tool's version (e.g. "g++ --version").

installCmd.description: Command that installs the tool into $LATTICE_TOOLCHAIN_DIR. Lattice runs it once per version and puts the install's `bin` on every task's PATH.

bin.description: Bin directory relative to the toolchain install (defaults to "bin"). It must be relative and stay inside the install: this directory is prepended to every task's PATH.

run.description: The command to run. Only valid in an override: the root `tasks` map says how a task behaves everywhere, not what it runs.

dependsOn.description: Tasks that must finish first. `build` means this workspace's build; `^build` means the build of every workspace this one depends on.

inputs.description: Globs, relative to the workspace, of the files hashed into the cache key. With none, every file in the workspace that git does not ignore is hashed.

outputs.description: Globs, relative to the workspace, of the files stored in the cache and restored on a hit. Replaces the default for the workspace's tool.

ignore.description: File globs excluded from input hashing.

env.description: Environment variable names that affect the task's cache key.

persistent.description: A long-running task, such as a dev server. It is never cached and nothing may depend on it. `dev`, `start`, `serve` and `watch` are persistent unless this says otherwise.

cache.description: Set false to always run the task. `clean`, `deploy`, `publish` and `release` are never cached unless this says otherwise.

timeout.description: How long the task may run before it is killed, e.g. "90s", "10m", "1h", or a whole number of seconds. The maximum is 31536000 (365 days). Ignored for persistent tasks.

maxCacheSize.description: Upper bound on the local cache size (e.g. "10GB").

cacheDir.description: Directory for the local cache, relative to the repo root (defaults to ".lattice/cache"). It must stay inside the repo and cannot be the repo root itself: `lattice prune` deletes cache archives and partial writes in whatever directory it names.

versionCheck.description: When true (default), compare the running binary against latticeVersion. Set false to run whatever binary is invoked.
